objectives.en: Prepare the Revaluation Account on retirement

narration.en: The firm's land has doubled in value while the retiring partner was with the firm. He deserves his share of that gain before he goes. So we revalue assets and liabilities and distribute reserves among all partners.
narration.kn: ನಿವೃತ್ತ ಪಾಲುದಾರ ಇದ್ದಾಗಲೇ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಬೆಲೆ ದ್ವಿಗುಣವಾಗಿದೆ. ಹೊರಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಆ ಲಾಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಪಾಲು ಸಿಗಬೇಕು. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಹೊಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ ಮೀಸಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಹಂಚುತ್ತೇವೆ.

title.en: Prepare the Revaluation Account on retirement

say.en: The firm's land has doubled in value while the retiring partner was with the firm. He deserves his share of that gain before he goes. So we revalue assets and liabilities and distribute reserves among all partners. In this lesson: Prepare the Revaluation Account on retirement.
Distribute reserves and accumulated losses.

body.en: The *Revaluation* Account is prepared exactly as on admission. Its profit or loss is shared by all partners, including the retiring partner, in the old ratio, because the change in values took place while he was a partner.
body.kn: ಪುನರ್ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರವೇಶದಂತೆಯೇ ತಯಾರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಲಾಭ ಅಥವಾ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ನಿವೃತ್ತನೂ ಸೇರಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.

title.en: Reserves and accumulated profits or losses

body.en: General reserve, credit balance of Profit and Loss Account and similar *accumulated profits* are credited to all partners in the old ratio. Debit balance of Profit and Loss Account and deferred revenue expenditure are debited to all partners in the old ratio.
body.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಮೀಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಚಿತ ಲಾಭಗಳು ಎಲ್ಲ ಪಾಲುದಾರರಿಗೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಮಾ. ಸಂಚಿತ ನಷ್ಟಗಳು ಹಳೆಯ ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಖರ್ಚು.

problem.en: A, B and C share 2:2:1. C retires. Building is appreciated by ₹20,000, machinery depreciated by ₹5,000 and provision for doubtful debts increased by ₹1,000. General Reserve is ₹25,000. Find each partner's share of the revaluation result and C's total credit from these items.

answer.en: A ₹5,600, B ₹5,600, C ₹2,800; C is credited ₹7,800 in all

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A, B and C share 2:2:1. C retires. Building is appreciated by ₹20,000, machinery depreciated by ₹5,000 and provision for doubtful debts increased by ₹1,000. General Reserve is ₹25,000. Find each partner's share of the revaluation result and C's total credit from these items.

say.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A, B and C share 2:2:1. C retires. Building is appreciated by 20,000, rupees machinery depreciated by 5,000 rupees and provision for doubtful debts increased by 1,000 rupees. General Reserve is 25,000 rupees. Find each partner's share of the revaluation result and C's total credit from these items.
Revaluation profit equals 20,000 minus 5,000 minus 1,000 equals 14,000 rupees.
Shares 2:2:1: A 5,600, rupees B 5,600, rupees C 2,800 rupees.
General Reserve: C's 1 over 5 of 25,000 equals 5,000 rupees.
C's credit equals 2,800 plus 5,000 equals 7,800 rupees.
So the answer is A 5,600, rupees B 5,600, rupees C 2,800 rupees; C is credited 7,800 rupees in all.
